output.subject: migration & outbound pipeline
output.body:
Hi Ryan,

I saw that ProtoPie announced the retirement of the legacy Individual Plan and migration of users to Pro on 24 July 2026, with a price-lock incentive. That migration effort needs a steady flow of qualified accounts without adding SDR headcount, which is exactly what Halyard's outbound pipeline engine provides. Would you be open to a brief 15-minute call to see how it could work for your growth team?

Priyanshu
